description: Improve the speed or resource use of existing code by measuring first, finding the actual hotspot, changing it, and measuring again with the behavior kept the same. Use when the user reports that something is slow, uses too much memory or CPU, or asks to optimize, speed up, or profile code. Do not use for failures or wrong results (use agent-kit:debugging), for restructuring without a performance goal (use agent-kit:refactoring), or for database query review alone (use the matching review skill).
